components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+'
            and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it
            must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when not
            supplied it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they knowingly share a
            household). Write-only; used only during create and not persisted or
            returned.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as "LastName, FirstName".
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A generated customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 4
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A generated membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who knowingly share a
                household (same last name and address). Assigned on create when
                'sharesHousehold' is true and another owner already shares the
                household; owners in the same household are given the same value.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create. Starts
                at 1, gains 1 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount
                is 0, and is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created on the same day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL'
                when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+'
            and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it
            must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when not
            supplied it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to
            derive the owner's 'ageBand'. Given and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they knowingly share a
            household). Write-only; used only during create and not persisted or
            returned.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer

## Summary

Implemented the `ageBand` derivation for owners, computed from an optional `birthDate` against the owner's `registrationDate`. Because the app generates its DTOs from the OpenAPI spec and maps them with MapStruct, the change spans the spec, model, mapper, and DB schema — no controller change was needed since the existing create flow already maps input fields and sets `registrationDate`.

Changes:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`**
   - Added `birthDate` (optional, `format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` (input) schema.
   - Added `ageBand` as a read-only enum (`MINOR`/`ADULT`/`SENIOR`) to the `Owner` (output) schema.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — added the persisted `birthDate` (`LocalDate`, `birth_date` column) field with getter/setter.

3. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added `@Mapping(target = "ageBand", …)` and an `ageBand(owner)` method: `MINOR` when the age at `registrationDate` is under 18, `ADULT` for 18–64, `SENIOR` for 65+; returns `null` when no `birthDate` is set (falling back to the current date only if `registrationDate` is somehow absent). `birthDate` itself maps straight through in both directions by name.

4. **DB schemas** (`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`) — added a nullable `birth_date DATE` column to the `owners` table.

The acceptance test posts an owner with `birthDate` `1990-01-01`; measured against the create-time `registrationDate` (2026), that yields `ADULT`, which the test asserts. `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — **BUILD SUCCESS**.
